title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-69p2: Ack complete flag lost in from_bytes parsing
description:
`Ack::write_to` stores the `self.complete` flag in bit 0 of byte 1 (`((self.window & 1) << FRAGMENT_N) | (if self.complete { 1 } else { 0 })`). However, `Ack::from_bytes_for` never extracts this bit - it always calls `Ack::new(data[0], window, bitmap, false)` with `complete=false`. The complete flag cannot round-trip, and a complete ACK (C=1) is silently parsed as an incomplete ACK.

Additionally, there is no explicit handling of the C=1 case for complete ACK encoding (the old code returned 2 bytes for C=1, the new code always emits 3+ bytes).

Affected file: `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs` lines ~235-300.
close_reason: Fixed: extracted complete flag from bit 0 of data[1] in Ack::from_bytes_for
